tools.name: vericlock_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by GUID: name, email, status and the group and job links. VeriClock API: GET /api/1.0/employee/{employeeGuid}.

tools.name: vericlock_get_group
tools.description: Get one group (a team of employees) by GUID, with its employee list. VeriClock API: GET /api/1.0/group/{groupGuid}.

tools.name: vericlock_query_payroll_items
tools.description: List payroll items (pay types such as hourly, overtime or salary), by GUID or status. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/payroll/query.

tools.name: vericlock_query_payroll_rules
tools.description: List the rules that map a pay type, job, service item, employee or group to a payroll item. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/payroll/queryRules.

tools.name: vericlock_get_caller_id_access
tools.description: List the caller ID access rules that let a phone number clock employees in and out. VeriClock API: GET /api/1.0/settings/accessControl/callerID.

tools.name: vericlock_get_ip_access_rules
tools.description: List the IP address access rules that limit where clock-ins are allowed. VeriClock API: GET /api/1.0/settings/accessControl/ipAddress.

tools.name: vericlock_query_timesheet
tools.description: Search clock events (time sheet entries) in a period, filtered by employee, group or job, with optional approval filter. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/timesheet/query.

tools.name: vericlock_query_timesheet_entries
tools.description: List timesheet entry objects for a period, optionally for some employees. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/timesheet/entries/query.

tools.name: vericlock_get_timesheet_entry
tools.description: Get one clock event by its instance GUID (not the root GUID). VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/timesheet/entry/get.

tools.name: vericlock_get_timesheet_entry_by_root
tools.description: Get the active revision of a clock event from its root GUID. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/timesheet/entry/getByRootGuid.

tools.name: vericlock_create_timesheet_entry
tools.description: Create a clock event for an employee: a start and end (or a duration), with optional job, service item and report. Writes time data. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/timesheet/entry/create.

tools.name: vericlock_create_payroll_item
tools.description: Create a payroll item (name, pay type and rate multiplier). VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/payroll/create.

tools.name: vericlock_update_payroll_item
tools.description: Change the set fields of one payroll item. Fields left out are kept. Status can only be active or inactive. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/payroll/{guid}/update.

tools.name: vericlock_create_payroll_rule
tools.description: Map a pay type, job, service item, employee and group to a payroll item. Every field is required. VeriClock API: POST /api/1.0/payroll/createRule.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vericlock_get_employee, vericlock_query_payroll_items, vericlock_query_payroll_rules, vericlock_query_timesheet, vericlock_query_timesheet_entries, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry_by_root · Public sink: vericlock_get_employee, vericlock_query_payroll_items, vericlock_query_payroll_rules, vericlock_query_timesheet, vericlock_query_timesheet_entries, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry_by_root, vericlock_create_timesheet_entry, vericlock_create_payroll_item, vericlock_update_payroll_item, vericlock_create_payroll_rule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vericlock_get_employee, vericlock_query_payroll_items, vericlock_query_payroll_rules, vericlock_query_timesheet, vericlock_query_timesheet_entries, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry_by_root · Public sink: vericlock_get_employee, vericlock_query_payroll_items, vericlock_query_payroll_rules, vericlock_query_timesheet, vericlock_query_timesheet_entries, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry, vericlock_get_timesheet_entry_by_root, vericlock_create_timesheet_entry, vericlock_create_payroll_item, vericlock_update_payroll_item, vericlock_create_payroll_rule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
